claims.claim: Maintained portable schema, frontend, package, and repository checks pass for the tested revision.
limitations: Does not establish native CUDA support or performance.

claims.claim: Exact recorded Windows x64 profiles demonstrate only the native behaviors recorded for those exact CUDA-JS revisions and physical environments.
claims.falsifier: The recorded command cannot reproduce the claimed native behavior on the stated revision/environment or provenance is incomplete.
limitations: Does not generalize to Linux, other Node/V8 versions, other hardware, or broad performance claims.

claims.falsifier: Absence or failure of a complete native Linux qualification rejects the claim.
limitations: Linux implementation/readiness is not native qualification.

claims.claim: CUDA-JS native behavior has been independently reproduced by an external third party.
claims.falsifier: An attempted reproduction fails under the stated supported environment or no independent packet exists.
limitations: Project-controlled runs and model review are not external reproduction.
